sources.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
sources.evidence: The launch identifies the public API model as gpt-6-astra and explicitly offers Fast mode for it at twice the Standard price. Fast is a processing mode; the page does not introduce a separately trained Fast checkpoint. Initial rollout was limited, with wider availability following.

sources.title: Fast mode
sources.evidence: Fast requests select service_tier fast or priority separately from the model ID. Standard and Fast share model rate limits, and Fast supports the multimodal capabilities available under Standard processing. The guide explicitly discusses Astra Fast eligibility and its lack of a latency SLA.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra API model reference
sources.evidence: Documents the sole listed gpt-6-astra snapshot, 1,050,000 context, 922,000 maximum input, 128,000 maximum output, text/image input, text output, reasoning and function calling. Fast pricing is listed on this same model page.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: September 3 explicitly releases GPT-6 Astra; tool calling requires Responses. September 29 separately introduces Astra Ultrafast using model gpt-6-astra and service_tier ultrafast. July 30 renames Priority processing to Fast before Astra existed.

sources.title: Safety overview: GPT-6 Astra
sources.evidence: Dated September 3 and explicitly announces the release. Describes training, alignment and safeguards for Astra, without numerical production parameters or network topology.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra System Card
sources.evidence: Original card and its later appendices were searched in full. The training section describes data and reinforcement learning; no production parameter count, active count, Transformer/MoE structure or separate Astra Fast checkpoint is disclosed. NanoGPT evaluation hyperparameters concern another model.

sources.title: GPT-6.1 Sol System Card
sources.evidence: Later card includes exact GPT-6 Astra comparisons and references its training description. Checked structural terminology and exact model comparisons: evaluation scores and response lengths are not parameter counts; no independent Fast variant is specified.

sources.title: GPT-6.1 Terra System Card
sources.evidence: October 26 card includes an exact GPT-6 Astra column, including HealthBench length-adjusted scores and response lengths. Its training and comparisons disclose no Astra total/active count or neural topology, and do not identify a separate Fast model.

sources.title: Public Summary of Training Content for GPT-6 Astra
sources.evidence: September 2 summary identifies Astra, says it is not a modification/fine-tune of a prior model, and records September 3 Union market placement. Quantities describe training data, not model parameters. It covers the underlying model, not an independently named Fast checkpoint.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: PDFs are supported as API inputs for vision-capable models and are converted to extracted text and page images. Combined with Astra vision support and Fast modality compatibility, this supports PDF as a document input format.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 provide limited non-exclusive service/API access and reserve OpenAI intellectual property. Together with hosted distribution, this supports descriptive Proprietary classification.

sources.title: OpenAI model inventory
sources.evidence: Lists gpt-6-astra, with no separately listed gpt-6-astra-fast. The open-weight section separately identifies gpt-oss checkpoints. The inventory does not offer downloadable Astra weights.

sources.title: Prompt caching
sources.evidence: Current guide describes KV states and GPT-6 caching behavior, but does not establish Astra production Transformer, dense or MoE topology. Pre-GPT-5.6 mechanism explanations are not transferred.

sources.title: Ultrafast mode
sources.evidence: Separately configures service_tier ultrafast with model gpt-6-astra. This later service tier is distinct from Fast and cannot supply the Fast release date or a separate checkpoint identity.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: The complete current document was checked for gpt-6-astra and gpt-6-astra-fast; no exact retirement entry was found. This does not test endpoint operation or validate a Fast-suffixed model ID.

sources.title: Attempted GPT-6 Astra Fast model reference
sources.evidence: The exact Fast-suffixed model-reference URL returned HTTP 404. This failed lookup is consistent with the separately documented processing tier, but is not alone proof of nonexistence.

sources.title: Models.dev GPT-6 Astra Fast record
sources.evidence: Accessed through the raw repository file. This catalog creates the Fast-suffixed row and gives September 4, but primary documentation instead uses the underlying Astra model ID with a separate service tier. It is a discovery lead rather than specification proof.

name.note: Display label combines the official model name with its documented processing mode; it is not a separate official model ID or checkpoint name.

developer.note: OpenAI develops and serves the underlying Astra model and Fast processing.

family.note: Normalize the underlying GPT-6 generation; Astra denotes the model tier and Fast the service tier.

release_date.note: Correct the catalog date using the September 3 release announcement and API changelog, with Fast explicitly offered in the launch post. This is the Astra-with-Fast launch date, not a separately trained model release. Rollout was staged; September 29 Ultrafast is distinct.

open_weights.note: Hosted access to Astra; reviewed primary distribution offers no downloadable weights for either the base model or a distinct Fast checkpoint.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-service classification under OpenAI terms, not an SPDX checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: Underlying Astra total is undisclosed in the original card, later exact-model comparisons and training summary. No independent Fast parameter count is specified. Training-data volumes and benchmark scores are unrelated.

active_parameters_b.note: No per-token active count or routing breakdown is disclosed for underlying Astra or a separate Fast checkpoint. Processing speed/pricing do not establish active weights.

architecture.note: Exact production topology remains unverified after original/later cards and targeted first-party architecture, training and interpretability searches. KV terminology does not establish Transformer/MoE structure. No separately trained Fast architecture is evidenced.

context_window.note: Retain the documented Astra window because Fast is its processing tier, not a different model ID. Explicit input/output ceilings are 922,000 and 128,000. No endpoint execution test was performed.

modalities.note: Fast retains Standard multimodal capabilities. Astra accepts text/images and generates text; PDF denotes API extraction into text/page images. Training audio/video and hosted image generation do not imply native sensory support.

reasoning.note: Astra reasoning remains available under Fast processing, with low, medium, high, xhigh and max effort; none is unsupported. Speed tier is separate from reasoning effort.

tool_call.note: Underlying Astra supports function calling and tools through Responses. Chat Completions is supported without tool calling; changing the speed tier does not remove that endpoint restriction.

description.value: GPT-6 Astra served through the API with Fast processing.
description.note: Replace the suggestion of a distinct high-volume model with the documented processing-tier relationship.

patch.notes: This frozen catalog row represents GPT-6 Astra with Fast processing, not an independently verified model or checkpoint. Official API requests use model gpt-6-astra and service_tier fast (or priority); gpt-6-astra-fast is not listed as an official model ID, and its attempted model-reference URL returned 404. The September 3 Astra launch explicitly offered Fast mode; September 29 introduced the distinct Ultrafast tier. Specifications refer to the documented underlying Astra model: 1,050,000 context, 922,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output. PDF is an API document format. Tool calling requires Responses. Total/active counts remain undisclosed and architecture unverified in the checked original and later sources. No exact retirement notice was found; endpoint operation and identical checkpoint bytes across serving tiers were not tested. This record duplicates an underlying-model release in a model-only count and should be considered for consolidation by the parent audit.

summary: Identified a catalog processing-tier row rather than a separately documented model: official requests use gpt-6-astra plus service_tier fast/priority. Clarify display name and description, normalize family and proprietary classification, correct launch-supported date to September 3, and replace catalog-only provenance. Retain documented underlying Astra capabilities with explicit scope; counts remain undisclosed and architecture unverified. Flag consolidation for parent review without deleting or merging the frozen record. Recommend excluding this processing-tier duplicate from independent-model release counts while retaining all 563 frozen audit assignments.

catalog_exclusion.reason: Processing-tier duplicate of openai/gpt-6-astra, not an independently documented model release. Official requests retain model gpt-6-astra and select Fast through service_tier fast or priority. Exclude this synthetic Fast-suffixed row from independent-model release counts while preserving its frozen audit assignment and report.
